item.title: Cyber Serpent Belt
item.description: Cyber Serpent laser engraved black leather belt worn with jeans. A high quality leather belt featuring intricate laser engraved psychedelic patterns inspired by the twisting form of a futuristic serpent. Organic curves, geometric details and hypnotic shapes flow around the belt, creating a bold design that feels part ancient creature, part cybernetic organism. Designed by 1000 Errors.
